hoped

course

improve
links
between

the
Arab
business
world

university
spokeswoman
said

The
Arabic
MBA

raise
the
profile
of
Heriot Watt University
and
the
Edinburgh Business School
among
businesses
in
the
Arabic-speaking
world
and
will
create
a
strong
network
of
graduates
in
the
region
.
The
first
intake
of
students
is
expected
later
this
year
.
Professor
Keith Lumsden
,
director
of
Edinburgh Business School
,
said
:
Arabic
is
a
major
global
language
and
the
Arab
world

a
centre
for
business
and
industrial

We

to
work
with
Arab International Education

the
demands

the
region
